prod_kopi_131.name: Sulawesi Toraja Luwak Coffee (Roasted)
prod_kopi_131.desc: Authentic luwak coffee selected from wild Toraja civets, naturally fermented, washed clean, and medium roasted. Dark chocolate aroma, wild-plant hints, and a creamy body without harsh bitterness.

prod_kopi_132.name: Malabar Pangalengan Arabica Coffee (Green Beans)
prod_kopi_132.desc: Green beans from Malabar estates at 1,400–1,600 m above sea level, grown among pine trees. Notes of mandarin orange, palm sugar, and a floral aftertaste typical of the southern Bandung highlands.

prod_kopi_133.name: Merapi Bantul Robusta Coffee Natural (Roasted)
prod_kopi_133.desc: Volcanic robusta from the slopes of Mount Merapi, natural full sun-dried process. Thick body, milk chocolate and roasted nut aroma, high caffeine — a favorite for espresso blends and modern milk coffee.

prod_kopi_134.name: Sanani Konawe Arabica Coffee (Green Beans)
prod_kopi_134.desc: Sanani is the oldest local variety in Southeast Sulawesi, cultivated since the colonial era at 900–1,200 m above sea level. Light herbal notes, milk chocolate, and low acidity that suits Asian palates.

prod_kopi_135.name: Pinang Belanda Jambi Robusta Coffee (Green Beans)
prod_kopi_135.desc: Pinang Belanda is a heritage variety from Jambi's plantation history, growing wild around the old city ruins. Sweet nutty flavor with spice hints and lower caffeine than common robusta.

prod_kopi_136.name: Surya Bajo Lombok Arabica Coffee (Roasted)
prod_kopi_136.desc: Surya Bajo arabica grows at 900–1,300 m above sea level facing the Alas Strait. An exotic profile of toasted coconut, mandarin orange, and milk chocolate with bright acidity typical of NTB's dry climate.

prod_kopi_137.name: Lintong Nihuta Toba Arabica Coffee (Green Beans)
prod_kopi_137.desc: Sigararutang arabica from limestone volcanic soil on the edge of Lake Toba at 1,400 m. Herbal notes, mandarin orange, and dark chocolate — a premium export favorite of Japanese roasteries.

prod_kopi_138.name: Petungkriyono Pekalongan Robusta Coffee (Roasted)
prod_kopi_138.desc: Premium robusta from Petungkriyono community forests at 1,200 m under pine shade. A 36-hour fermentation gives dark chocolate, caramel, and a subtle natural cinnamon note.

prod_kopi_139.name: Kalibaru Banyuwangi Arabica Coffee (Roasted)
prod_kopi_139.desc: Arabica from old estates on East Java's coast facing Mount Ijen. Milk chocolate, mandarin orange, and light honey with a soft body — suited to single-origin manual brew and retail packaging.

prod_kopi_140.name: Gayo Wine Process Arabica Coffee (Roasted)
prod_kopi_140.desc: Premium Gayo coffee with a 96-hour sealed anaerobic wine process — fermentation yields red wine aroma, tropical fruit, and wine-like sweetness highly sought by European and Japanese specialty roasters.
